legacyReadCompatibility: Saved subsets and completed artifacts retain their original identity; new complete-scope creation never accepts a client subset.

experimentBinding.strategyUniverse: Full ordered symbols/start/end exactly equal the frozen scope
experimentBinding.updateOmission: Inherit the prior version scope; cannot remove or shrink it by omission

experimentBinding.versionAtomicity: Experiment head, immutable revision, and scope association share one D1 transaction
